Elon Musk, the world's richest man, has spent more money to buy this year's
elections - [$474
million](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/02/us/politics/elon-musk-midterm-
spending.html) - than any donor in history, all to ensure Donald Trump can
keep asphyxiating America's democratic and constitutional order with abandon.

For Musk, that unfathomable sum means virtually nothing. It is roughly 0.05%
of his net worth.

Let us try to convey how little $474 million means to Elon Musk. If you
compare his worth to the median American's, Musk's political spending this
election cycle is equivalent to _$116_.

The obscene amount of cash Musk has dropped - to support 2026 Republican
candidates and help preserve President Trump's
[authoritarian](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/10/23/opinion/ilhan-omar-trump-
citizenship.html), [corrupt
](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Corruption_allegations_during_the_second_Trump_presidency)grip
on both chambers of Congress - is akin to an everyday American going to the
mall and buying both the new 'Grand Theft Auto' video game and a fancy coffee
tumbler.
